_readme: Copy this file to e.g. data/catalog/education_central.json (no leading underscore), keep the 'schemes' list and fill ONE object per scheme from an OFFICIAL source. Use null for anything the official document does not state - never guess. Only set rules_complete to true when the structured rules below capture ALL official eligibility conditions and you checked them (set last_verified too).

eligibility: Condition exactly as the official document states it
schemes.source_document: Name of the official guideline / notification

_field_help.category: One of: Education, Agriculture, Healthcare, Housing, Women & Child, Employment, SC/ST/OBC Welfare, Business
_field_help.applicable_state: All India, or the state/UT name(s)
_field_help.social_categories: e.g. ["SC", "ST"] or null if not restricted/unknown
_field_help.min_education: One of: Below 10th, 10th pass, 12th pass, Diploma / ITI, Graduate, Post-graduate, Doctorate
_field_help.last_verified: YYYY-MM-DD - the day you checked it against the official source
_field_help.bpl_required / minority_required / disab: true only if the official document makes this a requirement, otherwise null
